About this tile

A bright marble look with soft gold veining

BT Brazil Calcutta takes its cue from Calacatta marble, with a clean white base, flowing grey veins and fine touches of warm gold. The veining changes from tile to tile, so a finished floor reads as one natural surface instead of a repeated print.

It comes in three sizes. Use 300 x 600 on walls and in smaller rooms, 600 x 600 for an easy, balanced floor, and 600 x 1200 where you want fewer grout lines and a more open feel. Every size is packed to cover 1.44 m² per box, which keeps ordering simple.

BT Brazil Calcutta is a BT Special, one of the ranges Bonnyrigg Tiles chooses and imports directly. It is listed for indoor use. If you are matching it with other finishes, bring a sample of your benchtop or cabinetry to the showroom and our team will help you with a free colour consultation. You can also see it laid in a bathroom or kitchen before you decide.

Questions

Ordering BT Brazil Calcutta

How many boxes do I need?

Each box covers 1.44 m². Enter your area in the calculator above and it adds 10% for cuts, then rounds up to full boxes. For 12 m² that is 10 boxes.

Which size should I choose?

600 x 600 is the easiest all rounder for floors. 600 x 1200 gives fewer grout lines in larger rooms, and 300 x 600 suits walls and compact spaces. You can compare sizes on a floor in the tile visualiser.

How do I buy it?

Add it to your enquiry and send it to us. No payment is taken online. Our showroom team confirms stock and pricing with you, then you can pick up from Bonnyrigg or have it delivered across Sydney metro.

Will my tiles look exactly like the photos?

Colour and veining vary from tile to tile and between batches, and screens show colour differently. We recommend seeing BT Brazil Calcutta in person at our showroom before you order.
